newsitem.title: USA: Litton unit gets $11 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Litton unit gets $11 mln contract.

text.p: PRC Inc, a subsidiary of Litton Industries, Thursday said it has been awarded a five-year recompete contract worth $11 million from the U.S. Navy's Sea Systems Command.

Litton's PRC division will provide support to the Combat Systems Engineering Division at Wallops Island, Va. in support of the Airborne Early Warning/Ground Central Environment Integration Systems Combat Systems Center.
The work includes automated information systems support, management, and technical information support.
